correctness.rationale: The constant-length morphism has exactly eight adjacent two-letter factors and covers any length-L language via the image of all two-blocks under a power 2^j>=L. The finite certificate establishes eight length-five four-letter left-special prefixes with exactly {ac,db} two-letter contexts and injective binary coding on 56 length-eight factors. This promotes binary left-special factors of length m>=10 to both 01z and 10z contexts, of which exactly 8 exist using Berthé p(m)=8m-8. At n=12, exhaustive image classification gives only eight doubletons of type 01z/10z; no 00000 factor and a fixed-prefix inheritance argument exclude all other longer collisions, so rho(n)=8n-16 for n>=12. Independent direct initial binary generation yielded stated rho(1..12) and n=16,24,32. Binary and morphic conventions match the primary source.

Berthé established p(n)=8n-8 but did not evaluate tortoise images. The persistent exact deficit eight and threshold twelve are substantive special-context new computations with an infinite inheritance proof.
